title: Multi-point quasi-finite splitting variant: finite pieces with purely inseparable residue towers at chosen isolated fibre points
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> S separated locally of finite type, a point s and pairwise distinct isolated points x_1,...,x_n of the fibre X_s, the variant lemma produces an etale neighbourhood (U, u) -> (S, s) and an open-and-closed decomposition of U x_S X into a remainder W plus blocks V_{i,j} such that each V_{i,j} -> U is finite, its fibre over u is a single point v_{i,j} mapping to x_i with kappa(u) subset kappa(v_{i,j}) purely inseparable, and W's fibre over u misses all the x_i — the multi-point sharpening used to feed residue-field control into the Zariski-main-type splittings. The retained proof is written as an exact-copy directive: the argument is the base technical lemma's proof (lemma etale-splits-off-quasi-finite-part-technical, published chapter content) verbatim with its single-point gadget replaced by the multi-point gadget lemma etale-makes-quasi-finite-finite-multiple-points-var (both named), the substitution preserving every step since the base proof's only use of the gadget is the finite-piece construction. Retained author proof at lines 12161-12166.
